lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Port Halden, 2031. Six in the morning and the quay has been awake for three hours. Cranes, gulls, diesel, and a line of containers going somewhere nobody on this dock has ever been.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Four crates a week. Same consignor, same hill address, eighty years before anybody called it the Steward.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: You are looking for the first payment. This is where a thing gets a price and stops being an idea.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: It's a port. Somebody loaded it, somebody signed for it, and somebody got paid. That's all a beginning ever is.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The foreman is watching you from the weighbridge and has decided you are not from the union.
